title: Pressure test procedure
note: AI draft, engineer to confirm. DRAFT written by Claude from the rule books the library holds (order 14 lane P): each element cites its book, clause and page, and a held book's quote was checked by code on that stored page (scripts/playbook_quote_check.py, the quote check of gate G1). An element whose book is not held keeps its clause and reads 'book missing'. The cue words are a starting point, not a finding; a client discipline engineer confirms or changes every element before it is signed off.

elements.title: Systems and test type
elements.expects: The procedure names the piping, pipeline or equipment it tests and the kind of test (hydrostatic or pneumatic).

source.quote: This standard defines mandatory requirements governing pressure testing of new and existing metallic and non-metallic pipelines

elements.title: Test medium and its quality
elements.expects: The procedure names the test medium and the water quality it must meet.

source.quote: Testing fluid quality shall be as per SAES-A-007

elements.title: Chemical treatment of the test water
elements.expects: The procedure says which treatment chemicals are added and how they are injected to the specified concentration.

source.quote: Any treatment chemicals shall be continuously injected at a rate that will provide the specified concentration

elements.title: Approval of a pneumatic test
elements.expects: The procedure says that a pneumatic strength test is used only with the company's written approval.

source.quote: Pneumatic strength testing is not permitted without approval from below entities

elements.title: Leak test before a pneumatic test
elements.expects: The procedure has a low-pressure leak test before any pneumatic test.

source.quote: Prior to pneumatic pressure test a leak test shall be performed

elements.title: Test pressure and hold time
elements.expects: The procedure states the test pressure and how long it is held, with their basis.

source.quote: Test pressures and test durations shall be based on the applicable Saudi Aramco standards

elements.title: Static head of the test liquid
elements.expects: The procedure takes the static head of the test liquid into account (the pressure at the lowest and highest points).

source.quote: The effect of the static head of the testing liquid shall be considered

elements.title: Overpressure protection by a test relief valve
elements.expects: The procedure provides a relief valve on the test system, with its set pressure.

source.quote: of adequate capacity set to relieve at 5% above the test pressure shall be installed

elements.title: Calibrated gauges and recorders
elements.expects: The procedure requires the test gauges and recorders to be calibrated, with certificates.

source.quote: All gauges and recorders shall be calibrated prior to use.

elements.title: Number and range of gauges
elements.expects: The procedure states how many gauges are used, where, and their range against the test pressure.

source.quote: A minimum of two pressure gauges are required for the test system.

elements.title: Isolation of the test section
elements.expects: The procedure says how the test section is isolated (blinds, spectacle blinds or closed valves).

source.quote: Blind flanges, paddle blinds or spectacle blinds shall be used to isolate the test sections.

elements.title: Vents and drains
elements.expects: The procedure places vents at the high points and drains at the low points of the tested system.

source.quote: Vents shall be provided at all high points in the tested system as needed.

elements.title: Rating of temporary connections and the manifold
elements.expects: The procedure says the manifold, temporary piping and dummy spools are rated at least as the tested system.

source.quote: dummy spools shall be of same or higher-pressure rating as the piping system

elements.title: Raising the pressure in steps
elements.expects: The procedure raises the pressure gradually, in steps, with a check of joints at the first step.

source.quote: The pressure shall be gradually increased until a gauge pressure which is the lesser of one-half the test pressure

elements.title: Keeping people away from the test area
elements.expects: The procedure keeps people out of the test area while it is under pressure (barricade, waiting time).

source.quote: No one shall approach the test area for a minimum of 10 minutes after the test pressure is reached

elements.title: Test record
elements.expects: The procedure records the test on a pressure test report or chart.

source.quote: Test records shall be recorded on Pressure Test Report

elements.title: Disposal of the test fluid
elements.expects: The procedure says where and how the test water is drained and disposed of.

source.quote: The test fluid shall be disposed in accordance with SAEP-327

elements.title: Reinstatement after the test
elements.expects: The procedure removes the temporary items and reinstates what was removed or closed for the test.

source.quote: All temporary items installed for testing purposes

elements.title: Lay-up and preservation after the test
elements.expects: The procedure says how the system is laid up or preserved after the test.

source.quote: shall comply with the lay-up and preservation procedures per SAES-A-007

elements.title: Safeguards against oxygen ingress
elements.expects: The procedure has safeguards that keep oxygen out of the system during the test and lay-up.

source.quote: Hydrostatic testing and lay-up procedures shall contain safe-guards to prevent oxygen ingress

elements.title: Documentation the safety instruction asks for
elements.expects: The procedure includes the documents that GI-0002.102 paragraph 5.1.2.5 asks a pressure test procedure to include (named by SAES-A-004 5.8.2).
